startup_file.what: Runs premium flexible and managed workspace centres across India. It had 58 operating centres at the end of FY26 and 72 by July 2026.
how: Rent from customers who use its centres: Rs 173.6 Cr of Rs 201.3 Cr operating revenue in FY26, about 86%.

country.name: Germany
country.pr: Settlement permit after 27 months on a Blue Card with A1 German, or 21 months with B1 German.
country.citizenship: 5 years of lawful residence, roughly B1 German, financial independence. The 3-year fast track was abolished on 30 October 2025. Dual citizenship is permitted by Germany.
country.pro: Fastest realistic settlement on this list for a Blue Card holder: 21 to 27 months.
country.con: Political risk: the AfD won 44% in Saxony-Anhalt (early September 2026) and polled around 37% ahead of the 20 September votes in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Berlin. Its manifesto calls for a points system with German-language criteria and quotas for non-EU skilled workers, and mass deportations.
